tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Professor
professor.text: Education today mainly focuses on traditional careers like medicine, engineering, and law. However, the world is changing, and so are job opportunities. Many students might find their passion and success in nontraditional careers, such as content creation, entrepreneurship, or environmental science, which do not always follow the usual education paths. Should education systems continue to encourage traditional career paths or help students explore nontraditional career paths? Why?

posts.name: Student 1
posts.text: Education systems should definitely encourage students to explore nontraditional careers. It's about embracing diversity in student interests and talents. This approach not only helps students find fulfilling careers but also nurtures creativity and innovation. Traditional paths aren't for everyone, and education should reflect that.

posts.name: Student 2
posts.text: I believe education systems should continue to emphasize traditional career paths. These careers have been vital to our economy for a long time. By maintaining a strong connection with these fields, students can have clear pathways to secure jobs. It's about building on a proven foundation.
